newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer - no need to change M3 target zone for now.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer - no need to change M3 target zone for now.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday he saw no need to change the M3 money supply target zone for the time being.
"I see no reason at the moment for a change in the M3 money supply target," Tietmeyer told journalists after a Bundesbank news conference at the bank's annual out-of-town council meeting.
The Bundesbank's 1997 target range is 3.5 to 6.5 percent.
M3 money supply, a key Bundesbank indicator, grew in May at an anualised rate of 7.0 percent from the final quarter of 1996. In April, M3 grew 6.7 percent.
